bio: Droviss was never very good at taking orders, but her enthusiasm was invincible. Respecting her courage, her Ironband made her a drummer – and her first practice sent the whole barracks into a free-for-all brawl. Turned out she channels the rhythm of war itself. Now, she leads their every charge.
